title: Bollinger bands
description: Where the price sits inside its recent range. The bands sit two standard deviations either side of a moving average.

percent_b.label: Position in bands
percent_b.description: Where the price is between the bands, as a percentage. Above one hundred is outside the top band, below zero outside the bottom.

bandwidth_bps.label: Band width
bandwidth_bps.description: How far apart the bands are, in basis points. Narrow bands mean a quiet market that often precedes a move.

state.label: Band state
state.description: Upper when pressed against the top band, lower against the bottom, inside otherwise. Pressed readings tend to come back.
